**Job Title: Junior Data Entry Specialist – Work From Home**

**Company:** Global Tech Solutions
**Location:** Remote / Work From Home
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
**Salary:** ₹35,000 – ₹60,000 per month

### Job Description

We are urgently looking for motivated individuals to join our company as Junior Data Entry Specialists. No previous experience is required, and freshers are welcome to apply.

The selected candidates will be responsible for entering and updating company information, processing online forms, maintaining databases, and completing simple administrative tasks from home.

### Responsibilities

* Enter and update data into our online system.
* Process customer information and digital forms.
* Complete assigned tasks within deadlines.
* Maintain accurate records.
* Communicate with the team through online platforms.

### Requirements

* Basic computer knowledge.
* Good typing and communication skills.
* No prior experience required.
* Must have a smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection.
* Candidates from any educational background can apply.

### Benefits

* Work completely from home.
* Flexible working hours.
* Weekly salary payments available.
* No interview experience required.
* Immediate joining.
* Performance-based bonuses up to ₹20,000 per month.

### How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their **full name, mobile number, Aadhaar/PAN details, bank account information, and a copy of their identity proof** to the recruitment team.

**Contact:** [globaltechcareers2026@gmail.com](mailto:globaltechcareers2026@gmail.com)

**Note:** Selected candidates may be required to pay a refundable registration and verification fee of ₹2,999 before starting the job.

**Job Title: Junior Software Developer**

**Company:** ABC Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
**Experience:** 0–2 years

### Job Description

We are looking for a Junior Software Developer to join our engineering team in Bengaluru. The candidate will work with experienced developers to design, develop, test, and maintain software applications.

This position is suitable for recent graduates and candidates with up to two years of software development experience who are interested in building their technical skills in a collaborative environment.

### Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain software applications according to project requirements.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
* Participate in code reviews and debugging activities.
* Work with senior developers to understand technical requirements.
* Perform unit testing and help identify and resolve software defects.
* Collaborate with product, testing, and development teams.
* Learn and apply new technologies as required by the project.

### Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of Python, Java, or another programming language.
* Understanding of data structures and object-oriented programming.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.

### Preferred Qualifications

* Internship or academic project experience in software development.
* Familiarity with Git and version-control systems.
* Basic knowledge of web development or REST APIs.

### Benefits

* Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
* Health insurance and other employee benefits.
* Learning and professional development opportunities.
* Collaborative work environment.
* Paid leave according to company policy.

### Application Process

Interested candidates can submit their resume through the company's official careers portal. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an initial technical assessment followed by interview rounds.
